display.name: Self-Observability
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE startsWith(metric_name, 'otel_sdk_')
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.name: Services reporting
display.description: Number of services currently emitting OpenTelemetry SDK self-observability metrics.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('count(group by (service_name) ({__name__=~"otel_sdk_.+",service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Spans exported
display.description: Rate of spans that finished exporting successfully (`error_type` empty) across the selected services. See "Export errors" for the failed portion of the same counter.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum(rate(otel_sdk_exporter_span_exported_total{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), ',error_type=""}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

A non-zero value means `queue_full` or `already_shutdown` drops are happening; see the per-signal "processed error rate" panels in the Span pipeline / Log pipeline rows below for the breakdown.

display.name: Span processor queue utilization
display.description: Batch span processor queue utilization: current queue size as a fraction of capacity (`otel.sdk.processor.span.queue.size` / `otel.sdk.processor.span.queue.capacity`). At 100% the queue is full and the processor starts dropping new spans (reported as `error_type="queue_full"` in the "Spans processed error rate" panel below).

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_span_queue_size{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_span_queue_capacity{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '})'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

display.name: Spans processed error rate (by error type)
display.description: Rate of spans that were DROPPED by the span processor (never reached the exporter), broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "Spans started rate" for total volume). `error_type` is `queue_full` (the processor's queue was full) or `already_shutdown` (submitted after the processor was shut down). Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

spec.query:

ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

display.name: Span export operation duration (avg)
display.description: Average duration of the span exporter's export call (`otel.sdk.exporter.operation.duration`, filtered to span exporters). Distinct from "Spans exported error rate", which measures success/failure, not latency. Shown as an average (sum/count) rather than a percentile because the SDK currently reports this histogram with a single `+Inf` bucket, which makes `histogram_quantile` always return NaN.

spec.query:

ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

display.description: Distinct services with an overflow point reported in the selected time range. Zero means no overflow observed, not proof that every SDK supports or reports cardinality limits.

spec.text:
Overflow preserves measurement values but loses their measurement attributes.

For synchronous instruments:
- **Cumulative:** once capacity is exhausted, new attribute combinations continue overflowing until SDK state is reset, typically by restarting the service. Previously tracked combinations continue normally.
- **Delta:** overflow can stop in subsequent collection cycles when active cardinality falls below the limit.

This dashboard shows overflow **observed within the selected time range**, which can remain visible after recovery.

[Learn about cardinality limits](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/signals/metrics/#cardinality-limits)

Classic histogram components are grouped under their base Prometheus name only when matching _bucket series with an le label are present for the same service instance and scope. The suffix regex extracts a candidate base name; unmatched names are preserved. A row indicates presence, not lost measurement count, configured limit, or current overflow activity.
